question: does the same-direction ON minus OFF difference seen in the two R2 pairs persist when four seed pairs are available?

rule.applies_to: the unfiltered online stop rule over all four seed pairs, so the verdict does not depend on the pair-comparability filter
rule.otherwise: the online block is treated as reflecting run-to-run variability rather than a stable instrument effect and the same-input replay decides
rule.pause_if: all four pairs show a same-sign, non-zero difference on the same outcome AND the mean difference exceeds the measured reference repeatability of the earlier N0 block
rule.unknowns_not_tested_by_this_block: a closed-loop timing effect that is smaller than the run-to-run spread of these outcomes
